description: Envelope generator with attack, decay, sustain, hold and release stages, a curve control on three of them, and a gate output for each stage

params.text: Sets the attack time, 0.1ms to 1 second
Sets the decay time, 0.1ms to 1 second
Sets the release time, 0.1ms to 1 second
Bends the attack from exponential at the bottom, through linear at the centre, to logarithmic at the top
Bends the decay from exponential at the bottom, through linear at the centre, to logarithmic at the top
Bends the release from exponential at the bottom, through linear at the centre, to logarithmic at the top
Sets the level the envelope holds at after the decay, 0V to 8V
Runs the envelope round on its own, one cycle after another; while it is on, the GATE IN jack is not read
Sets how long the envelope holds at the sustain level after the gate falls, before the release begins, up to 1 second

inputs.text: A rising edge starts the envelope and holding it high holds the sustain stage
Adds to the ATTACK knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the DECAY knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the RELEASE knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the SUSTAIN knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits
Adds to the HOLD knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's limits

outputs.text: An 8V gate, high for as long as the envelope is in its attack stage
An 8V gate, high for as long as the envelope is in its decay stage
An 8V gate, high for as long as the envelope is in its release stage
An 8V gate, high for as long as the envelope is in its sustain stage
An 8V gate, high for as long as the envelope is in its hold stage

notes: The number of voices follows the GATE IN jack's channel count, up to four.
